objective: Audit the merged 0.1.2-1 hotfix against every requirement of Intent intent-0mvp7hcqf-t7pm and separate substantiated discrepancies from verified behavior.
scope: The Intent's requirements in its intent.json under .holyagent/ (read it)
constraints: Read-only. Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on. When done and checked, stop and report; do not add unrequested features, files or refactors. Make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Skip the marketplace-dependency requirement and the session-status notes; those are tracked separately.

criteria.text: Each User requirement on migrate (mapping, dry run, refusal to overwrite, Running stop, reload, holycodex TOON support, lossy choices recorded in help text) is met or the gap is named with file:line

Each SessionStart requirement (legacy notice with migrate command, core rules and most-missed block; takeover line for a non-holyagent main thread; silence without any folder) is met or the gap is named
The required tests exist for each listed case, or the missing case is named
--input is supported on the JSON-reading commands so the root writes no draft files
No unrequested features, files or refactors in the diff

result:
result: Audit of 0.1.2-1 against Intent intent-0mvp7hcqf-t7pm: the migrate, SessionStart takeover, legacy-notice and test criteria are met or have named gaps, but the `--input` criterion is only partly met and two Intent requirements are discrepant (lossy "every Intent Open", and specialists not reinforced). No checks were run because this session has no shell.
changed: none (read-only; no edits, no version-control or .holyagent writes)
checks: none run. No shell tool here, so no `bun test` (migrate, input, cli, sessioncontext, hooks test files), no `mise run verify`, no `git show`/`git status`. Verdicts rest on reading the diff (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/955f248d-75f2-5c36-9dd0-d4e898af84ee/scratchpad/hotfix-0.1.2-1.diff) and the working-tree sources, which matched the diff for legacy.ts (763 lines), migrate.ts (227), sessioncontext.ts (CONTEXT_BUDGET 9300) and identity.md, so the evidence is from a stable tree.
blockers: none for the audit itself
questions:
- Intent item 2 says lossy choices include "every Intent Open", but migrate writes closed legacy Intents as Closed (legacy.ts:406, :588). Should the requirement or the code win?
- `dist` is tracked (.git/index lists dist/scripts/holyagent), the working-tree bundle and plugin.json already read 0.1.2-1 with the new text, but the diff has no dist hunk. Root: run `git show --stat <merge 451a782> -- packages/integrations/claude/dist` to confirm the merged commit carries the rebuilt plugin, since marketplace.json points at dist.
- Accept `assignment close --report-json` (JSON on stdin, no --input) as the documented stdin exception, or add --input?
- Restore "Model-facing text is in US English." to the root core? It was removed from ROOT_CORE and now only sits in the full-prompt file.
notes:
- Unrequested scope: migrate lists project files that name a legacy folder via git grep (migrate.ts:128-152, :189, :222); holycodex intent-0 schema reader (legacy.ts:167-171, :685-691); CONTEXT_BUDGET 9,000 to 9,300 (sessioncontext.ts:9), which narrows the margin under the host's 10,000 cut; identity.md rewording beyond the reinforcement, including dropping "about delegating or asking" (identity.md:5); the US-English rule moved to root/instruction-guidelines.md:5, which is not in ROOT_CORE_FILES (root-core.ts:11-16).
- Risk: payloadOf reads host.stdin even when --input is given (context.ts:63), and main.ts:9-15 reads stdin to EOF when it is not a TTY, so a never-closed pipe would hang the command. Not reproduced.
- Risk: writeAll (migrate.ts:89-98) has no rollback. A mid-write I/O failure leaves some records, and a rerun then refuses with "already exists" (migrate.ts:80-81). The MigrationUnverified hint (errors.ts:521-522) covers only reload failure.
- Edge: a `.holyclaude/` holding only `local/` state (legacy.ts:494 returns undefined only for no files) keeps the hook notice (hook.ts:209-211) and makes migrate report migrated:true with zero records.
- Unverified: legacy command names in Stop messages (`holyclaude assignment finish|cancel`, `holycodex-agent assignment result|recover`, `intent current`; migrate.ts/legacy.ts ~545, ~674, ~728) and the holycodex schema against github.com/davidbasilefilho/holycodex, since those sources are not in this repo.
- Not audited: branch/PR (root's), the marketplace and session-status items (skipped per Assignment), the holycodex 0.16.12 CLI study, and the "prove it works for real" follow-up (needs a shell).
evidence:
Each User requirement on migrate (mapping, dry run, refusal to overwrite, Running stop, reload, holycodex TOON support, lossy choices recorded in help text) is met or the gap is named with file:line: Met except one named gap. Mapping: legacy.ts:396-487 (holyclaude), :576-651 (holycodex), writes via encodeJson and commitFile (migrate.ts:89-98). Dry run: migrate.ts:195-207 prints counts, unconvertible, stops, conflicts. Refusal to overwrite: migrate.ts:63-86 and re-check under lock at :209-216. Running stop: legacy.ts:541-547 (holyclaude), :723-731 (holycodex executing), :670-675 (pending transaction). Reload: migrate.ts:100-121 and :217. No delete or commit in migrate.ts. TOON: legacy.ts:223-227, :684-694. Gap, file:line: lossy choice "every Intent Open" departs at legacy.ts:406 and :588 (closed Intents become Closed), recorded accurately in migrate.ts:158 and :161, and asserted as Closed in migrate.test.ts ("maps the Intent..." and "reads the earlier intent schema and closes a complete Intent").
Each SessionStart requirement (legacy notice with migrate command, core rules and most-missed block; takeover line for a non-holyagent main thread; silence without any folder) is met or the gap is named: Met for plain and non-holyagent sessions. Legacy notice: hook.ts:207-218, sessioncontext.ts:78-83 (legacyContext; names migrate --dry-run and migrate, appends SESSION_REMINDER). Takeover: sessioncontext.ts:21-22 (ROOT_TAKEOVER), hook.ts:199-206 (core path when agent_type is not holyagent or holyagent:holyagent; plugin root filled in). Silence: hook.ts:212-213 returns NOTHING when no legacy folder. Gap, named: for agent_type holyagent or holyagent:holyagent the core is omitted (hook.ts:202-204), while the requirement says "includes the core root rules"; docs/hooks.md describes this on purpose. Root to decide.
The required tests exist for each listed case, or the missing case is named: Present by name, not executed. Fixture migration with states, acceptance, non-portable paths, notes, missing fields, and reload: migrate.test.ts "converts every record and the project reloads through the CLI", "maps Intents, Assignments, acceptance and non-portable paths as documented", "copies the notes unchanged...", holycodex "converts every status...", "maps the Intent, the statuses...". Dry run: "prints counts per source...", "says a clean tree would be written...", "reports a Running Assignment...". Refusal and Running stop: "never overwrites: a second run fails...", "stops on a Running holyclaude Assignment...", "stops on an executing holycodex Assignment...", "stops on a pending holycodex transaction...". Hook: hooks.test.ts "prints nothing in a project without a .holyagent folder, whatever the agent", "tells a main thread that is not the root...", "a project with only a legacy folder gets the migrate notice...", "names both legacy folders...". Input: input.test.ts covers the four --input commands. Missing: none of the listed cases. Not covered: a mid-write failure in migrate.
--input is supported on the JSON-reading commands so the root writes no draft files: Partly met. Supported with shared payloadOf (context.ts:55-99; program.ts:47, :57-58) on intent create (intent.ts:70), intent update (intent.ts:127), assignment create (assignment.ts:150, :154) and assignment dispatch (assignment.ts:174, :178). Gap, named: assignment close --report-json reads JSON from stdin (assignment.ts:250, :269-274) and has no input flag, so --input is refused as "Unknown flag" (args.ts:35). docs/usage.md says a specialist report always goes on stdin. Root to decide whether this is the exception.
requirement-matrix:
  1 migrate build: verified (see criterion 1); gaps as named there.
  2 lossy choices in help: discrepant (Closed vs "every Intent Open", legacy.ts:406, :588).
  3 holycodex conversion with same guarantees: verified by reading (legacy.ts:652-747); schema fidelity to the external repo unverified.
  4 SessionStart legacy notice, core and reminder: verified; discrepant for holyagent main thread (hook.ts:202-204).
  5 SessionStart takeover line and silence: verified (sessioncontext.ts:21-22; hook.ts:199-213).
  6 tests exist: verified by name; not executed.
  7 root reinforcement: verified (identity.md:3, :5; session-reminder.md:1; requirements.md R-ROLE; AGENTS.md "The session agent"); regression: "Model-facing text is in US English" removed from ROOT_CORE, now only instruction-guidelines.md:5 (outside ROOT_CORE_FILES, root-core.ts:11-16).
  8 every agent including specialists follows rules without reminder: discrepant. The diff has no hunk under packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/specialist/ (8 files), and the only specialist text is the existing SPECIALIST_RULES version-control text (hook.ts:146, :269-273).
  9 bump to 0.1.2-1 via bump:hotfix: verified in shape (scripts/bump-version.ts:94-99 VERSION_FILES plus bun.lock; mise.toml:76-78 runs bump then build). dist not in diff; see questions.
  10 conventions, build and gates: unverified (no shell; mise run verify not run).
  12 --input: partly met (see criterion 4).
discrepancies:
  D1 (Intent item 2, lossy choices): legacy.ts:406 and :588 write closed Intents as Closed, where the requirement lists "every Intent Open"; help text migrate.ts:158, :161 records the implemented choice.
  D2 (Intent item 4, legacy notice core): hook.ts:202-204 omits the core for holyagent and holyagent:holyagent, while the requirement says the context "includes the core root rules". Consistent with docs/hooks.md, so this is by design unless the requirement is literal.
  D3 (Intent item 8, specialists): no specialist prompt changed; packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/specialist/*.md contains no "without being reminded" text. The root-only reinforcement is in identity.md, session-reminder.md and requirements.md R-ROLE.
  D4 (Intent item 12 / criterion 4, --input): assignment.ts:269-274 reads JSON from stdin with no --input (args.ts:35).
  D5 (regression, unrequested): ROOT_CORE (root-core.ts:11-16, identity.md:3) no longer states "Model-facing text is in US English"; the rule now lives only in the full-prompt instruction-guidelines.md:5. Non-root main threads that receive only the core lose it.
  D6 (unverified delivery): dist is tracked and the working-tree bundle carries 0.1.2-1 and the new text (dist/scripts/holyagent.js, dist/.claude-plugin/plugin.json:3), but the diff has no dist hunk; whether the merged commit contains the rebuilt plugin is unverified.
